definition: Globally unique id for this action (assistance_transaction_unique_key / contract_transaction_unique_key). The de-duplication key.
Generated unique id of the parent award (*_award_unique_key). The join key to everything award-level.
PIID of the parent IDV for delivery orders placed under a vehicle.
assistance or contract - which of USAspending's two file layouts the row came from. Required context for action codes.
grant / contract / idv / direct_payment / loan / other - the revenue-treatment grouping.
Type code (04; A; IDV_B; ...). Blank on contract IDV rows in the raw data; filled from idv_type_code with an IDV_ prefix.
Stable label from the code via us_classify_award_type(). Never taken from source description strings; those are unstable.
Human-facing award number: FAIN (assistance) or PIID (contracts). Agencies reuse these - never join on it alone.
Alternative assistance identifier. Its numeric suffix is regenerated per system and is not stable across sources - never key on it.
The action's modification number (0 or blank = the base action).
When the action was signed. The date the panel books money on.
Calendar year of action_date.
Federal fiscal year of action_date (starts 1 October). Recomputed; the source's fiscal-year column is never trusted.
What kind of action. Codes collide across families (B = Continuation for assistance; Supplemental Agreement for contracts).
Stable label from the code and family via us_classify_action().

Economic intent: origination / continuation / revision / funding_only / adjustment / termination / closeout / administrative / unclassified. Intent - never infer a de-obligation from it; use the sign of the amount.
FABS correction/delete indicator: C = this row IS the current correction (kept); D = record withdrawn (dropped in normalization). Legacy values L and _ are kept and flagged.
2/3 = entity-level record. 1 = county-level aggregate with no identified recipient (dropped in normalization).
Signed dollars committed by this action. The revenue measure. Negative = de-obligation.
USAspending's loan-aware variant (generated_pragmatic_obligations): equals the obligation except for loans where it is the subsidy cost. Contracts have no such column; filled from the obligation.
Cost share from non-federal parties. Not federal revenue.
Face value of a direct or guaranteed loan - the borrower's liability. Never revenue.
The government's expected loss on the loan. Not a payment to the recipient.
Award-LIFETIME obligation stamped as of file generation. The reconciliation target; a property of the pull date not of the transaction.
Award-lifetime outlays to date. Blank on most rows; no annual version exists anywhere in award data.
SAM.gov UEI of the recipient at the time of this action (cleaned and uppercased). Can change over an award's life - NIH awards follow the PI between institutions.
Recipient legal name as registered.
UEI of the recipient's parent registration in SAM.
Recipient state code.
Toptier code of the agency that made the award.
Name of the awarding toptier agency.
Code of the awarding sub-agency (e.g. NIH under HHS).
Name of the awarding sub-agency.
Code of the agency whose money it is when different from the awarding agency.
Name of the funding agency.
Assistance listing (program) number - e.g. 84.268 = Federal Direct Student Loans.
Assistance listing title.
Industry code of the contracted work.
Product/service code of the contracted work.
Period of performance start.
Period of performance current end.
When USAspending last touched the record. The de-duplication tiebreaker and the vintage marker.
Provenance: which raw file (or archive: scan) the row came from.
Flag: this action carries a zero obligation (majority of modifications). Added by us_normalize_transactions(); absent from a raw extract.
Flag: negative obligation. Added by us_normalize_transactions().
Flag: undocumented legacy correction_delete_code value (L or _) - kept. Added by us_normalize_transactions().
Flag: recipient_uei was not in the requested set (the API matches on text). Added by us_normalize_transactions().
Pipe-separated anomaly flags (non-zero administrative action; action outside period of performance; impossible date). Added by us_normalize_transactions().
